claims: Monitor intracranial pressure (ICP) closely due to elevated readings.
Continue mechanical ventilation with settings adjusted to maintain oxygen saturation above 92%.
Administer IV fluids as needed to maintain blood pressure and volume status.
Monitor electrolytes, particularly potassium, closely and adjust supplementation as needed.
Continue intravenous antibiotics for suspected infection.
Assess and manage pain as needed with analgesics like morphine.
Continue monitoring heart rate and rhythm to ensure stability.
Continue close monitoring of respiratory parameters to ensure adequate oxygenation and ventilation.
Assess the patient for cognitive function and adjust sedation accordingly to maintain an appropriate Richmond Agitation-Sedation Scale (RASS) score.
Monitor for signs of infection and adjust prophylactic antibiotics if necessary.
